keyLight: BAKED in every "px": true material: the greenery px kit's tiles are pre-lit at its fixed upper-left key (docs/art/rigs/px-greenery-harmony-kit/Art/Textures/TerrainPx/README.md). NOT baked in lawn or sandstone, which are still this kit's own pass bakes.
pxFlip: 2026-09-17, PR 1 of 3 (albedo). A "px": true material's live PNGs, all three ladder steps, ARE the px kit's bytes: copied, never re-baked or hand-edited, and TerrainKitAlbedoBytesTests proves it by sha256. The px kit ships every material at 256 px / 8 m, so the seven plan materials that were 512 px / 16 m moved into the one 256 array and the 512 array retired (owner ruling A2). Mud is new: splat index 19, _SplatE.a (owner ruling M1). The terrainBake*.js pass bakers still describe the RETIRED bakes, with their own size tables, and no longer make the live tiles; "pass" records the bake pass that introduced a material.
pass9: 2026-09-25, terrain pass 9 PR 2 (the ground). path is new: the pass 9 kit's gravel track, for splat index 20 on _SplatF.r (docs/design/st-peters-terrain-pass-9.md §5); it takes a chunk offset like dirt, because a gravel track has no lie to slice. docs/art/rigs/terrain/pass9/bakePass9.js bakes every "px": true material from that kit through TerrainLight6: the albedo from the light's unlit, and the engine contract's _normal, _light and _detail beside it. The bake's maps land under Art/Terrain together with the arrays they pack into; until then the live albedo stays the px kit's bytes, as above.
